name: Sliding-window (local) attention, often interleaved with global layers
change: Local layers attend only to the last W tokens, so their cache stops growing at W - 1 resident tokens; a few global layers keep full attention.
problem_solved: With full attention, KV grows in every layer for every token. Capping most layers makes long-context memory grow only in the global layers.
trade_off: Local layers forget beyond the window; long-range recall depends on the global layers.
kv_formula: global: 2 × L_global × H_kv × d_head × b per token; local: capped at (W - 1) tokens
